title: Origin story: Starforge
description: Starforge was a blacksmith's apprentice the night a star fell on the forge-town. She gathered the star-iron while it still sang with heat, and learned to work metal that remembered being a star. Her blades hold starlight; her plowshares never dull. She forges for heroes, and charges only the story of the deed.

title: Ability profile: Starforge
description: Ranked abilities: Star-smithing — rank 100/100; Metallurgy — rank 98/100; Artistry — rank 96/100; Judgment of heroes — rank 95/100; Strength — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Starforge
description: Powers: Star-iron remembers the sky; Her forge burns with stellar heat; Her works cannot be broken by mortal means.

title: Stamina feats: Starforge
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Worked the star-heart for a year and a day; Forges still, never tiring.

title: Crossover notes: Starforge
description: Starforge crosses naturally with: star-metal, the forge of heaven.

title: Design notes: Starforge
description: The sky as material; the smith of falling stars.
